status: Completed layer-two evidence is recorded in layer2_results.json; numerical and conservation audits pass, dry cases improve, reacting boundary-layer timing regressions remain disclosed.
commands_working_directory: repository root, with OpenFOAM10 sourced first

incremental_native.role: Accepted layer-one interface GPU path with CPU materials; controls interface changes during layer-two timing.

independent_math.role: Untouched original CPU dry math and validation driver.

baseline.final_full_pipeline_comparison: Must additionally compare final all-layer applications against 88bc5434.

external_source_note: Cases root is a local non-Git directory; file hashes identify the exact tools, with no invented commit.

isothermal_adiabatic.checks: Independent exponential parent mass, closed caloric temperature, mass/element/energy balances, first-order time convergence.

surface.checks: Analytic thermal resistance plus surface mass action and ALE pressure work; wall temperature, consumption rate, recession, element and energy balances.

darcy.checks: Compressible p-squared solution, first-order upwind donor flux, discrete divergence, core flux equivalence.

unequal_diffusion.checks: Independent integrated mixture potential, zero-sum common correction and first-order asymptotic spatial convergence.

zero_support.checks: Three-species unequal diffusion, nonnegative inventory, each-species and energy closure, temperature preservation; no floors or limiters.

native_baseline.native_checks: All CSV fields including momentum and species plus per-cell condensed masses, 8 reaction-progress channels, pore masses, energy, volume and porosity from every checkpoint. Final checkpoint bitwise identity is additional evidence, not required numerical acceptance.
native_baseline.dry_stoichiometry: C0 -> 0.3 C1 + 0.2 S0 + 0.5 S1. Each invariant includes gas and pore inventories; reaction progress + C0 is constant. No false requirement of individual-species conservation under reaction.
native_baseline.original_analytic_tolerance: Final C0 versus 500*exp(-2*t): abs error < .002 kg; original first-order integrator unchanged.

schema_adapter.verification: Fixed fingerprint independently recalculated from frozen 88bc FieldSchema literal; unchanged state-tail offsets, body checksum and original external numeric assertions.
schema_adapter.note: Original schema8-only wrapper rejects both old and new schema9 executables before physics assertions. No original test file or tolerance was modified.

candidate_matrix.name: native_material_core
candidate_matrix.checks: Four original thermal/single/diffusion/dry cases; physical tolerance and closure applied to every run.

candidate_matrix.name: surface_and_prepared_wall
candidate_matrix.recipe: Use unchanged chmt-moving-short and stored constantTransport/reactingSst 8-window, 4-microstep inputs against v2 and candidate. Repeat Euler and SSPRK3; audit condensed withdrawal, emitted species, pressure/viscous work, total energy and recession geometry.

candidate_matrix.name: dry_restart
candidate_matrix.recipe: Restart candidate from each selected mid-window accepted checkpoint generated by original dry input; compare final CSV and per-cell progress/condensed/pore/energy with its continuous run. Original checkpoint bytes retained.

candidate_matrix.name: failure_semantics
candidate_matrix.recipe: Reaction and transport CUDA oracles cover positivity exhaustion, empty pore support, workspace reuse, and original rejected-domain semantics; preserve diagnostics and never add a production fallback.
candidate_matrix.status: Agent-owned oracle reports to be attached after final source stabilizes.

timing.physics: Original dry mechanism and material parameters; only uniform mesh refinement. CPU implicit conduction participates unchanged.
timing.formal_method: After correctness passes, five alternating baseline/candidate samples and one excluded warmup pair. Complete solver process time includes startup/output; mesh/audit excluded. Serialize GPU jobs and heavy compiles. Preserve entire failed cohorts; no silent retry or dropped samples.
timing.status: Inputs prepared and meshed only; no formal layer-two speed claim.

scope_limits: CPU dryMaterialFoam tests are mathematical oracles, not evidence that GPU production integration is complete.
Source-rate kernels, surface closure and transport buffers require separate frozen CPU/CUDA comparisons from owning agents.
No third-layer assembly/solver or thermal model change is made by this validation work.
All native binaries currently available use fast-compile=max; default-production compiler limitations remain recorded in layer1_results.json.
